stages.title: Seed Preparation & Nursery Sowing
stages.description: Select certified disease-free seeds. Soak seeds for 24 hours, incubate for 48 hours, and sow on raised nursery beds.

stages.title: Transplanting
stages.description: Transplant 20-25 day old seedlings into puddled fields. Maintain a shallow water depth of 2-3 cm.

stages.title: Active Tillering & Top Dressing
stages.description: Apply first top-dressing of Nitrogen (Urea). Perform mechanical weeding and monitor for stem borer.

stages.title: Panicle Initiation & Flowering
stages.description: Ensure standing water depth of 5 cm. Apply phosphorus and potassium. Keep pests monitored.

stages.title: Drainage & Harvesting
stages.description: Drain water 10 days before harvest. Harvest when 85% of panicles turn golden brown and grains are firm.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds at 5 cm depth with 60cm x 20cm spacing. Ensure optimum moisture in soil beds.

stages.title: Seedling Stage & Thinning
stages.description: Thin out weak seedlings. Perform first weeding. Monitor for fall armyworm emergence.

stages.title: Knee-High Stage & Top Dressing
stages.description: Apply urea near the base. Earth up plants to provide support. Apply second irrigation.

stages.title: Tasseling & Silking
stages.description: Maintain constant soil moisture. Avoid drought stress as it directly impacts pollination efficiency.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when grain moisture drops to 20% and husks turn straw-colored.

stages.title: Land Prep & Sowing
stages.description: Broadcast seeds in fine tilth soil. Maintain moisture for germination.

stages.title: Thinning & Weeding
stages.description: Thin plants to keep 10-15 cm spacing. Manual weeding is critical.

stages.title: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Apply top dressing of Nitrogen. Monitor for yellow mites and semilooper.

stages.title: Harvesting & Retting
stages.description: Harvest at small-pod stage. Tie in bundles and submerge in slow-running water for retting (15-20 days).

stages.title: Fiber Extraction
stages.description: Extract fibers from retted stems, wash in clean water, and hang on bamboo frames to dry.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow in ridges. Apply pre-emergence herbicide if weed pressure is high.

stages.title: Squaring Phase
stages.description: Flower buds (squares) begin to appear. Perform weeding and apply first split of nitrogen.

stages.title: Flowering & Boll formation
stages.description: White flowers turn pink and fall off, leaving bolls. Keep pests (bollworm) monitored closely.

stages.title: Boll Bursting
stages.description: Bolls split open revealing white cotton fibers. Suspend irrigation to allow drying.

stages.title: Picking & Harvesting
stages.description: Perform handpicking of clean dry cotton. Avoid picking damp or leaf-mixed bolls.

stages.title: Seedling Planting
stages.description: Plant selected 9-12 month old seedlings in 1m x 1m x 1m pits filled with topsoil, organic manure, and sand.

stages.title: Young Palm Care
stages.description: Provide regular watering during dry seasons. Mulch basin to retain moisture. Spray against red palm weevil.

stages.title: Annual Manuring
stages.description: Apply organic compost, neem cake, and recommended chemical NPK dose in the circular basin.

stages.title: Flowering & Fruit Set
stages.description: Infestation monitoring. Regular fertilizer application continues. First inflorescence appears around year 4-5.

stages.title: Harvesting Cycle
stages.description: Harvest mature coconuts every 45-60 days. Select nuts based on brown husk maturity markers.

stages.title: Nursery & Transplanting
stages.description: Sow in polythene bags. Transplant 45-day-old robust seedlings into pits with spacing of 2m x 2m.

stages.title: Vegetative Phase
stages.description: Apply nitrogen and phosphorus. Remove weeds and monitor for ring-spot virus vectors.

stages.title: Flowering & Sex Expression
stages.description: Identify male/female plants. Maintain 1 male plant for every 10 female plants for pollination.

stages.title: Fruit Development
stages.description: Thin out crowded fruits. Apply potassium fertilizers to improve sweetness and fruit sizing.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when skin color begins to turn yellow starting from the apical end of fruits.

stages.title: Orchard Planting
stages.description: Plant budded plants in summer. Ensure good soil drainage. Apply organic compost.

stages.title: Pruning & Training
stages.description: Train young plants to have single main trunk up to 1 meter. Remove water suckers regularly.

stages.title: Irrigation & Nutrients
stages.description: Apply fertilizer ring doses. Keep soil moist but avoid waterlogging around collar zone.

stages.title: First Flowering
stages.description: Allow minor fruit set in year 3. Maintain pest sprays against citrus psylla and leaf miner.

stages.title: Harvesting Cycle
stages.description: Harvest fully mature orange fruits with sweet-acid flavor. Clip stalk carefully to prevent skin tears.

stages.title: Planting & Staking
stages.description: Plant rootstocks during winter dormancy. Support dwarf varieties with stakes or trellis.

stages.title: Bud Break & Green Tip
stages.description: Apply preventive copper sprays for scab protection. Nitrogen application during early vegetative push.

stages.title: Flowering & Pollination
stages.description: Introduce honeybees for pollination. Irrigate regularly during fruit set phase.

stages.title: Fruit Thinning & Cover
stages.description: Thin fruits to one per cluster to improve sizing. Apply calcium sprays to prevent bitter pit.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest based on ground color change and seed color (must turn dark brown). Handle carefully.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow directly on raised beds covered with plastic mulch. Spacing 1.5m x 0.5m.

stages.title: Vine Growth
stages.description: Irrigate via drip systems. Monitor for red pumpkin beetle and powdery mildew.

stages.title: Flowering
stages.description: Flowering starts. Introduce honeybees. Apply potassium-rich liquid fertilizers.

stages.title: Fruit Netting
stages.description: Netting pattern forms on skin. Restrict irrigation to raise sugar content and prevent cracking.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest at 'full slip' stage (when the stem separates easily from fruit under slight pressure).

stages.title: Planting
stages.description: Sow 2-3 seeds per hill on raised channel beds. Keep soil warm and damp.

stages.title: Vine Training
stages.description: Guide vines along the soil beds. Keep fields free of competing weeds.

stages.title: Pollination & Fruit Set
stages.description: Bees active. Place fruits on straw beds to prevent soil rot. Apply liquid NPK.

stages.title: Fruit Expansion
stages.description: Rotate fruits occasionally for uniform color. Irrigate deeply but avoid sudden water swings.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when the tendril nearest to the fruit dries up and the bottom ground spot turns creamy yellow.

stages.title: Pruning
stages.description: Prune vines in winter (dormant pruning). Clean and tie canes to the trellis wires.

stages.title: Bud burst & Shoots growth
stages.description: New green shoots emerge. Apply nitrogen and keep downy mildew sprays active.

stages.title: Flowering & Fruit Set
stages.description: Grapes flower. Apply gibberellic acid (GA3) if seedless variety to increase berry size.

stages.title: Veraison (Color Change)
stages.description: Berries soften and turn red/purple/yellow. Reduce irrigation to boost sugar levels.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Test sugar levels (Brix value > 16). Clip bunches manually and store immediately in shade.

stages.title: Orchard Cleanup & Pruning
stages.description: Remove dead wood after last harvest. Apply organic manure and water.

stages.title: Flower Initiation
stages.description: Flower panicles emerge. Control powdery mildew and leafhoppers with light sprays.

stages.title: Fruit Set & Pea Stage
stages.description: Fruits set. Apply irrigation to prevent young fruit drop. Soil application of potash.

stages.title: Marble & Development Stage
stages.description: Monitor fruit fly infestation. Bag fruits if exporting. Limit moisture swings.

stages.title: Harvesting Cycle
stages.description: Harvest when shoulder rises and skin color shifts to light green-yellow. Harvest with stalk.

stages.title: Sucker Planting
stages.description: Plant healthy sword suckers in deep pits. Spacing 1.8m x 1.8m.

stages.title: Early Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Apply high dosage of nitrogen and potassium. Keep soil moist through drip irrigation.

stages.title: Bunch Emergence (Inflorescence)
stages.description: The flower bract emerges. Remove male buds (denaveling) once all hands are open.

stages.title: Fruit Calibration & Bagging
stages.description: Cover bunches with blue polyethylene sleeves to protect from scars. Propping with bamboo stakes.

stages.title: Harvesting Cycle
stages.description: Harvest when fruit ridges become round and skin color shifts from dark green to light green.

stages.title: Bahar Treatment & Pruning
stages.description: Withhold water for 30 days to induce dormancy. Prune, apply manure, then irrigate to force bloom.

stages.title: Flowering & Pollination
stages.description: Hermaphrodite flowers set fruit. Spray micro-nutrients to reduce flower drop.

stages.title: Fruit Development
stages.description: Apply potassium and calcium to prevent fruit cracking. Bag fruits to protect from butterflies.

stages.title: Coloring & Maturity
stages.description: Arils turn red and sweet. Keep irrigation steady. Avoid extreme soil moisture fluctuations.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when fruits turn yellow-red and produce metallic sound when tapped.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Treat seed with Rhizobium. Sow in line at 2-3 cm depth. Best suited in Rabi.

stages.title: Emergence & Nodulation
stages.description: Rhizobium root nodules develop. Perform early hand weeding. Soil must not be waterlogged.

stages.title: Flowering
stages.description: Apply light life-saving irrigation. Monitor for pod borers and rust disease.

stages.title: Pod Filling
stages.description: Pods expand. Ensure soil has moderate residual moisture.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when foliage turns yellow and pods dry to a rattling sound.

stages.title: Seedbed Preparation & Sowing
stages.description: Sow in line. Seed treatment with Rhizobium culture is recommended.

stages.title: Weed Management
stages.description: Perform weeding at day 15. Keep field free of competing grasses.

stages.title: Flowering & Pod Initiation
stages.description: Monitor for whitefly vectors (Yellow Mosaic Virus). Apply potassium.

stages.title: Pod Development
stages.description: Ensure moisture in soil. Spray crop canopy with micro-nutrients to increase yield.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when 80% pods turn dark brown/black. Dry crop on threshing yard.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds at 3-4 cm depth. Space rows 30 cm apart.

stages.title: First Weeding
stages.description: Perform hand weeding. Check for thrips and early leaf spots.

stages.title: Flowering & Branching
stages.description: Apply first light irrigation. Top dress with phosphorus and sulfur.

stages.title: Pod Development
stages.description: Keep checking crop health. Maintain adequate soil moisture for pod filling.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Perform handpicking of mature dry pods in multiple pickings as they ripen unevenly.

stages.title: Direct Sowing
stages.description: Highly drought-resistant legume. Sow in sandy dry soils with start of monsoon rains.

stages.title: Early Canopy Spread
stages.description: Crop spreads as green carpet. Weeding is not critical as it acts as weed suppressor.

stages.title: Flowering & Nodulation
stages.description: Yellow flowers appear. Symbiotic nitrogen fixation starts. Check for leafhoppers.

stages.title: Pod Growth
stages.description: Develops pods under dry conditions. Avoid excessive water which causes root rot.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when entire plant dries up. Cut close to ground level and thrash.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow in ridges. Require nitrogen fertilizer as nodulation is weak in this crop.

stages.title: Vegetative Support
stages.description: Weed and earth up the ridges. Ensure soil is moist but well-drained.

stages.title: Flowering & Pod Set
stages.description: Apply phosphorus booster. Keep irrigation cycles steady. Monitor for aphids.

stages.title: Pod Filling
stages.description: Ensure moisture. Grains expand in pods. Protect from pod borer caterpillars.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when plants shed leaves and pods turn brown and dry.

stages.title: Sowing & Early Care
stages.description: Sow at start of monsoon. Slow early growth, often intercropped with sorghum.

stages.title: Secondary Weeding
stages.description: Keep base clear of weeds. Root system grows deep searching for moisture.

stages.title: Active Vegetative growth
stages.description: Develops tall woody shrub structure. Apply second dose of fertilizer.

stages.title: Flowering & Podding
stages.description: Yellow-red flowers bloom. Critical pest protection window against pod fly and plume moth.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when pods turn dry. Cut plants at base, bundle, dry, and beat to extract seeds.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds at 8-10 cm depth to avoid wilt disease. Best in cool Rabi climate.

stages.title: Nipping Stage
stages.description: Pluck top branch tips (nipping) to promote lateral branching and increase pod yield.

stages.title: Flowering
stages.description: Apply first irrigation. Inspect for pod borer (Helicoverpa). Set up pheromone traps.

stages.title: Pod Development
stages.description: Ensure soil residue moisture. Spray NPV or neem extract if caterpillars are seen.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when leaves turn yellow-brown and pods rattle when shaken.

stages.title: Pruning & Shade Control
stages.description: Prune unproductive suckers. Maintain 50% shade cover using overhead canopy trees.

stages.title: Blossom Irrigation
stages.description: Apply blossom showers (sprinkler) to trigger uniform bud break and white flowering.

stages.title: Berry Development & Nutrition
stages.description: Berries set. Apply NPK fertilizer blends and organic mulch around basins.

stages.title: Berry Ripening
stages.description: Berries turn from green to bright cherry red. Spray against coffee berry borer.

stages.title: Selective Picking
stages.description: Harvest only fully ripe red cherries in multiple rounds. Pulp cherries within 24 hours.
